title: Five steps from a hand to a helper.
lead: Each one is necessary. Together they lead to a robot that can do what we do.

milestones.title: A hand as capable as ours
milestones.summary: Five fingers and 20 joints that can pinch, grip and turn things the way a human hand does.

milestones.title: Senses
milestones.summary: Touch in the fingertips and eyes on the world, so it can feel and see what it holds.

milestones.title: Learned skills
milestones.summary: Skills learned from practice and from people: pouring, cutting, folding, using tools.

milestones.title: Understanding tasks
milestones.summary: Ask for something in plain words, and it plans the steps and carries them out.

milestones.title: At work in a real home
milestones.summary: Two arms and two hands helping with cooking and chores, safely, around people.
